Hero.title: Your country home, ready in 90 days.
Hero.lead: Modular homes built in our factory, trucked to your plot and assembled in three days.
Hero.imageAlt: Dark timber modular house on a grassy ridge at sunrise, with a misty valley and mountains behind

Models.title: Six models, from 1 to 4 modules.
Models.lead: Same structure, same finishes, same warranty. Only the size changes.
Models.plan: {count, plural, one {Floor plan with # module} other {Floor plan with # modules}}

casulo.name: Casulo
casulo.description: One module, one room. A hideaway for two, or a studio at the back of your land.
casulo.imageAlt: Casulo model: single-module house with a glazed end, in tall grass at the edge of a eucalyptus wood

ripa.name: Ripa
ripa.description: Two modules end to end: bedroom at one end, living and kitchen at the other, light on both sides.
ripa.imageAlt: Ripa model: long, slim two-module house in a golden field at dusk

varanda.name: Varanda
varanda.description: Two modules side by side, with a covered porch running the full length.
varanda.imageAlt: Varanda model: two-module house with a covered timber porch along the front, in a green pasture

serra.name: Serra
serra.description: Three modules in an L, designed for sloping land. Two bedrooms and a living room facing the view.
serra.imageAlt: Serra model: three-module L-shaped house on posts on a slope, with araucaria trees behind

patio.name: Pátio
patio.description: Four modules around an inner courtyard. City-house privacy in the middle of the countryside.
patio.imageAlt: Pátio model: four modules in a U around a courtyard with a tree, seen from above

longa.name: Longa
longa.description: Four modules over two floors, three bedrooms. Room for the whole family.
longa.imageAlt: Longa model: two-storey four-module house on a lawn with trees behind

About.title: A real house, built in a factory and assembled on your land.
About.body: Every Pouso is built in our factory in Extrema, Brazil, from 3 × 6 m modules with a steel frame, treated timber and full insulation. While you sort out the paperwork for your land, the house is already being built. When it's ready, it goes on a truck and is assembled in three days.

delivery.caption: from signed contract to keys in hand

homes.caption: delivered to mountains, coast and countryside

assembly.caption: of on-site assembly, with our own crane and crew

cunha.title: Mountain house, Cunha, Brazil
cunha.body: A slope steep enough to scare off any contractor. Steel posts took up the grade, and the house now floats above the pasture with the living room facing the valley.
cunha.imageAlt: Dark L-shaped modular house on a green pasture slope, with araucaria trees and mountains behind, late afternoon

rosa.title: Beach house, Praia do Rosa, Brazil
rosa.body: Two modules and a glass facade facing the ocean. The coastal scrub was left untouched: the house sits on posts and barely touches the ground.
rosa.imageAlt: Dark modular house on posts atop a hill of coastal scrub, with the ocean and a beach behind

sapucai.title: Country house, São Bento do Sapucaí, Brazil
sapucai.body: A couple from São Paulo wanted weekends in the country without two years of construction. From contract to their first night in the house: 84 days.
sapucai.imageAlt: Modular house with a covered porch in a fenced pasture, with a large granite dome on the horizon

Quote.title: Get a quote for your land
Quote.lead: Tell us which model you're considering. A consultant checks access to your land, transport and foundations, then sends you a fixed quote.
Quote.imageAlt: Empty hillside plot at dusk, with a wooden fence and stakes marking where the house will stand
